activity.notes: Margaret exercised governing power in Denmark from 1376, first as guardian for her son Olaf and after his death as independent regent. ATLAS records this Danish pre-Kalmar phase through 1397, when the existing Kalmar Union Activity begins.

sources.title: Margrete 1. — Lex
sources.citation_text: Lex states that Margaret exercised governing power in Denmark from 1376 to 1412, in varying capacities as guardian and ruler in her own right.
